Patient: Emma Wilson
Recovering from knee surgery. Can return to desk duties on 18 November. Avoid lifting more than 5 kg or standing for longer than 20 minutes until review on 9 December.

History of bipolar II. Takes lamotrigine 100 mg at night. Reports poor sleep for the past three nights. No recent medication changes.
